108.
(1) Where  an employee of the Central Bank or a
qualified person authorized by the Central Bank is satisfied,
after examination by himself or any examiner of the affairs
of  any  banking  institution,  or  upon  information  received
from the banking institution, that the banking institution is
insolvent or is likely to become unable to meet the demands
of its depositors, or that its continuance in business is likely
to involve loss to its depositors or creditors, the employee of
the Central Bank or the qualified person authorized by the
Central Bank shall make a report accordingly to the Governor
of the Central Bank for submission to the Central Bank.
